one_leg_operator.J_link: bounded operator on H_orb representing omega_link

pairing.role: complete forward/reciprocal polarized two-output linking metric
pairing.diagonal_warning: it is an off-diagonal polarization; no positive one-leg norm or scalar Wronskian coefficient determines it alone

orientation.meaning: ordered slot reversal flips linking orientation

fourier.assumption: J_link was constructed by summing transported presentation forms
fourier.law: G_link commutes with simultaneous quarter-turn transport up to the declared reciprocal orientation

wall_and_regular_content.wall: represented by the p^(-1/2)-weighted jump/average-trace term
wall_and_regular_content.combined: both occur in the same K_link and cannot be independently renormalized

hostile: Any proposed two-output metric with diagonal linking blocks or with S^*GS=+G fails ordered orientation before Evans evaluation.
disposition: The formerly missing complete polarized two-output linking metric is forced by the bounded skew Riesz operator. Its block matrix is bounded, Hermitian self-adjoint, analytic-transpose symmetric, and odd under slot exchange. Only identification with the old conservative linking port remains.
